# Popular Office Furniture Brand Websites

Here are some well-known office furniture brands and their websites:

## Major Brands
- **Herman Miller** - hermanmiller.com
- **Steelcase** - steelcase.com
- **Haworth** - haworth.com
- **Knoll** - knoll.com
- **Humanscale** - humanscale.com
- **Teknion** - teknion.com
- **Kimball** - kimball.com
- **HON** - hon.com
- **Global Furniture Group** - globalfurnituregroup.com

## Mid-Range/Popular Brands
- **IKEA Business** - ikea.com/business
- **Office Depot/OfficeMax** - officedepot.com
- **Staples** - staples.com
- **Autonomous** - autonomous.ai
- **Branch** - branchfurniture.com
- **FlexiSpot** - flexispot.com

## Luxury/High-End
- **Vitra** - vitra.com
- **Poltrona Frau** - poltronafrau.com
- **Cassina** - cassina.com

## Budget-Friendly
- **IKEA** - ikea.com
- **Wayfair Professional** - wayfair.com/professional
- **Amazon Business** - amazon.com/b2b

These brands offer everything from ergonomic chairs and desks to complete office solutions and collaborative workspaces.
